steps.code:
res_prompt = primitives.call(name='get_capx_prompt', agent_context=None)
if res_prompt.ok:
    print("Prompt:", res_prompt.output)

res_grasp = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='sample_grasp_pose', native_api=True, parameters={'object_name': 'red cube'})
print("sample_grasp_pose ok:", res_grasp.ok, "output:", res_grasp.output)

res_obj = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='get_object_pose', native_api=True, parameters={'object_name': 'red cube', 'return_bbox_extent': True})
print("get_object_pose ok:", res_obj.ok, "output:", res_obj.output)

get_object_pose.doc:
Get the pose of an object in the environment from a natural language description.
The quaternion from get_object_pose may be unreliable, so disregard it and use the grasp pose quaternion OR (0, 0, 1, 0) wxyz as the gripper down orientation if using this for placement position.

Args:
    object_name: The name of the object to get the pose of.
    return_bbox_extent:  Whether to return the extent of the oriented bounding box (oriented by quaternion_wxyz). Default is False.

Returns:
    position: (3,) XYZ in meters.
    quaternion_wxyz: (4,) WXYZ unit quaternion.
    bbox_extent: (3,) XYZ in meters (full side length, not half-length extent). If return_bbox_extent is False, returns None.

goto_pose.doc:
Go to pose using Inverse Kinematics.
There is no need to call a second goto_pose with the same position and quaternion_wxyz after calling it with z_approach.
Args:
    position: (3,) XYZ in meters.
    quaternion_wxyz: (4,) WXYZ unit quaternion.
    z_approach: (float) Z-axis distance offset for goto_pose insertion approach motion. Will first arrive at position + z_approach meters in Z-axis before moving to the requested pose. Useful for more precise grasp approaches. Default is 0.0.
Returns:
    None

home_pose.doc:
Move the robot to a safe home pose.
Args:
    None
Returns:
    None

Args:

    quaternion_wxyz: (4,) WXYZ unit quaternion.

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
grasp_pos = res_grasp.output['native_api_result'][0]['values']
grasp_quat = res_grasp.output['native_api_result'][1]['values']

# Open gripper first
r_open = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='open_gripper', native_api=True, parameters={})
print("open_gripper:", r_open.ok)

# Go to grasp pose with z_approach
r_goto = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='goto_pose', native_api=True, parameters={
    'position': grasp_pos,
    'quaternion_wxyz': grasp_quat,
    'z_approach': 0.1
})
print("goto_pose:", r_goto.ok, r_goto.output)

# Close gripper
r_close = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='close_gripper', native_api=True, parameters={})
print("close_gripper:", r_close.ok)

# Lift up by 0.25m in Z
lift_pos = [grasp_pos[0], grasp_pos[1], grasp_pos[2] + 0.25]
r_lift = primitives.call(name='submit_capx_action', action='goto_pose', native_api=True, parameters={
    'position': lift_pos,
    'quaternion_wxyz': grasp_quat,
    'z_approach': 0.0
})
print("lift goto_pose:", r_lift.ok, r_lift.output)

# Observe scene
r_obs = primitives.call(name='observe_capx_scene', agent_context=None, prompt=None, query=None)
if r_obs.ok:
    pub = r_obs.output.get('public_observation', {})
    print("cube_pos:", pub.get('cube_pos'), "cube_poses:", pub.get('cube_poses'))
    print("robot_cartesian_pos:", pub.get('robot_cartesian_pos'))
